thread:
maria: Hey team — getting a handful of customer tickets about tail latency on /v1/generate in prod right now. p95 looks fine but p99 jumped from ~420ms to ~980ms starting ~06:22 UTC. Any quick checks?

alex: thanks for flagging. are the errors or just slow responses?

maria: mostly slow, not 5xx. Support pasted a stacktrace showing long wait on kv cache miss and some queuing. No obvious deploys in last hour.

sam: I'm seeing the same in dashboards: the panel for api.request_latency:quantiles shows p99 up. But the histograms panel (per-second rollups) shows a staircase spike — suspicious. Could be bucketization / aggregation artifact.

chloe: @maria can you paste the support repro? Also any customer region?

maria: pasted below (sanitized):
```
Request: POST /v1/generate
avg_tokens: 48
client_region: us-east-1
observed_latency_ms: 1050
stack snippet: waiting on kv cache miss for prefix 'user-xxx'
```

alex: I ran `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(api_request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))` and saw the p99 bump in the same window. But if I run `quantile_over_time(0.99, api_request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])` the curve isn't identical. Need to pin down which panels are using pre-aggregated rollups vs raw buckets.

observability-bot: Reminder: dashboard "API Latency (per-route)" panel uses pre-aggregated minute rollups from the metrics-aggregator job.

sam: aha. that explains the staircase shape. When traffic is bursty and sample counts per minute are low, rollup quantiles can behave oddly and exaggerate p99. The raw histogram query (sum over buckets) tends to be smoother.

chloe: Do we know if the alerts use the rollup-based panel or the raw query?

alex: Alert `api-p99-regression` triggers off the metric `api.request_latency.quantile.p99.rollup` (derived). So alert and dashboards aren't consistent. That mismatch probably caused the on-call ping but also confused support.

sre-oncall: I can mute the alert to avoid noisy pages while we investigate, but we should push a mitigant quickly. Suggestion: change alert to use histogram_quantile over bucket sums for now and add `or vector(0)` to keep it stable.

maria: For immediate customer mitigation, any runtime knobs? Can we reduce per-request queuing or disable batching to avoid long tails?

sam: We saw a small regression in batching policy last week where the batch cap was increased; that can increase head-of-line wait for tiny requests. Rolling the cap back reduces p99 but increases overall token cost. If customers are impacted, we can temporarily lower cap for their org or route.

alex: Also, there was a KV cache GC job that started at 06:20 in prod (per infra-runbook) — might have caused increased misses. I'll check infra logs.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-15T06:15Z by infra-team: metrics-aggregator v1.3.2 -> v1.3.3 (rollup tweaks).

chloe: that deploy could explain dashboard/alert differences if rollup logic changed. Need to confirm what changed in v1.3.3. @alex can you get the changelog?

alex: grabbing changelog now.

alex: changelog snippet: "metric-aggregator: change default minute-rollup bucket boundary alignment; add linear interpolation for quantile fallback under low-sample conditions (opt-in)." Looks like we rolled it without opt-in flag.

sam: so the aggregator changed boundaries, which will shift bucket counts slightly and can cause apparent p99 diffs. Combined with KV GC and batching cap tweak, multiple small things likely multiplied.

maria: Proposed action items: 1) mute `api-p99-regression` alert and update to histogram_quantile over sum of buckets; 2) roll back minute-rollup change or enable interpolation opt-in; 3) verify KV GC timing and pause if needed; 4) offer affected customers temporary lower batch cap.

chloe: agree. I'll own #1 and #2. alex can do #3 with infra. sam can scope #4 with support.

alex: infra logs show KV GC job started 06:21:08 and iterated heavy keys — I'll request a pause and check for any correlated spike in cache miss rate: `rate(kv_prefix_miss_total[1m])` shows a 8x spike during 06:21-06:24.

sre-oncall: I've muted the alert and added a note in the alert runbook.

chloe: I've updated alert query to use: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(api_request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```
and lowered eval window to 3m for quicker detection of real regressions. Pushing change now.

chloe: Also created a temp dashboard panel showing raw bucket-based p99 vs rollup p99 side-by-side for next 24h.

sam: Support action: emailing impacted customers with apology and temporary config change option. I'll coordinate org-level rollbacks.

alex: infra paused KV GC at 06:35. Cache miss rate folded back to baseline within ~90s.

maria: so root cause summary: rollout of metrics-aggregator rollup change made dashboards/alerts diverge; coincident KV GC + recent batching cap increase magnified real tails. Mitigations applied: alert query fixed, KV GC paused, option to lower batch cap offered to impacted orgs.

chloe: closing loop: I'll open a follow-up ticket to revert rollup change or make interpolation opt-in and add an automated dashboard test that compares rollup vs raw-bucket p99 to catch this in staging.

maria: thanks all — good cross-team work. :pray:
